consumer.description: If set, the plugin will activate only for requests where the specified consumer has been authenticated.

consumer_group.description: If set, the plugin will activate only for requests where the specified consumer group has been authenticated.

route.description: If set, the plugin will only activate when receiving requests via the specified route.

service.description: If set, the plugin will only activate when receiving requests via one of the routes belonging to the specified Service.

protocols.description: A list of the request protocols that will trigger this plugin.

decision_api_url.description: Full URL of the NVIDIA Switchyard Decision API, including the path `/v1/decision` (for example, `http://switchyard:4000/v1/decision`).

decision_route.description: Route or profile name configured in Switchyard server (for example, `kong-router`). Sent as the `model` field of the nested decision request.

prompt_disclosure.description: Scope of prompt content disclosed to Switchyard. Under `none`, message content is replaced with `[redacted: N chars]` markers so routing leaks no prompt text. Higher disclosure levels include `latest_user_prompt`, `recent_message_window`, or `full`.

targets.description: Map of pre-approved target configurations that Switchyard decisions are permitted to select. Keys are target IDs (for example, `weak`, `strong`). Decisions naming unlisted targets are refused and fall back to `default_target`.

model_alias.description: Model alias recognized by AI Proxy Advanced when dispatch is `model_alias`.

model.description: Underlying LLM model name (for example, `z-ai/glm-5.3`, `google/gemini-3.8-flash`). Verified against the decision to prevent model drift.

provider.description: Optional upstream provider identifier for telemetry and logging.

protocol.description: Protocol format used by the target LLM provider.

base_url.description: Approved base URL for the target, used to assert that Switchyard has not been repointed to an unauthorized upstream.

upstream_url.description: Target upstream base URL, used only when dispatch is set to `upstream` (stub/no-license testing).

default_target.description: Fallback target key in `targets`, used whenever Switchyard is unreachable, times out, or returns a rejected decision.

mode.description: Operational mode. `observe_only` evaluates routing without modifying traffic. `enforce` actively applies the decision.

dispatch.description: Dispatch mechanism. `model_alias` rewrites `body.model` for resolution by AI Proxy Advanced. `upstream` retargets the Service's upstream URL.

inbound_profile.description: Inbound protocol profile advertised to the Switchyard Decision API.

inbound_endpoint.description: Inbound request endpoint matching the advertised profile.

session_from_prompt.description: Derive the session ID from a prompt hash when the client does not supply an `X-Session-Id` header.

timeout_ms.description: HTTP timeout, in milliseconds, when querying the Switchyard Decision API. On expiry, requests fall back open to `default_target`.

keepalive_timeout.description: Keepalive idle timeout, in milliseconds, for HTTP connections to Switchyard.

keepalive_pool.description: Maximum idle connections kept in the pool for the Switchyard Decision API client.
